intro: We study how computers understand, create and interact with the visual world. Our research connects computer graphics and vision, from sketch-based modeling and editable CAD to 3D animation and generative video.

home.intro: We are a computer graphics and vision lab in the School of Informatics at the University of Edinburgh. We develop intuitive ways to understand, create and animate the 3D world.

featured.caption: Intuitive tools for creating and editing CAD models.
Turning creative intent into expressive motion.
